name: cpu_per_replica
meaning: (cpu_cores / ready_replicas) / 0.100, i.e. fraction of the 100m CPU request per Ready replica -- a NOMINALLY COMPARABLE proxy to HPA's averageUtilization/100, not literally identical to it (docs/rl_mdp_spec.md sec.4, CORR-27).

name: cpu_per_replica_delta
meaning: current step's cpu_per_replica minus its 90s EWMA (momentum/trend, not a raw one-step difference).

name: memory_per_replica
meaning: (memory_bytes / ready_replicas) / 67108864, i.e. fraction of the 64MiB memory request per Ready replica.

name: in_progress_per_replica
meaning: requests_in_progress / ready_replicas -- secondary queueing-pressure signal, redundant with CPU on this CPU-bound app but retained per Phase 15A evaluation for robustness.

name: request_rate_norm
meaning: sum(rate(demo_app_requests_total{route="/work"}[1m])), normalized against a 100 RPS design ceiling, justified ONLY from non-held-out development profile peaks (burst=70, ramp=60, step=50 RPS). Never justified from any held-out evaluation workload's parameters (CORR-27; see docs/rl_mdp_spec.md sec.22).

name: request_rate_delta
meaning: current step's request_rate_rps minus its 90s EWMA.

name: p95_latency_norm
meaning: latency_p95_seconds (ms), normalized against a 2000ms ceiling (~6.67x the 300ms SLA target). If request_rate_rps==0 with no histogram observations, this is semantically 0ms ("no_traffic", CORR-27) -- not a telemetry failure; see docs/rl_mdp_spec.md sec.6.

name: p95_latency_delta
meaning: current step's p95 latency (ms) minus its 90s EWMA.

name: error_rate
meaning: error_rate_rps (5xx only, live-observable) / request_rate_rps; 0.0 if request_rate_rps==0; null (missing) if request_rate_rps is null.

name: ready_replica_norm
meaning: (replicas_ready - 2) / (8 - 2) -- authoritative physical capacity, never hpa_status_current_replicas (CORR-25). V2 Phase 4D-B / CORR-55 -- raw_min changed from 1.0 to 2.0, the V2 replica floor is now 2, never 1.

name: seconds_since_last_scale_norm
meaning: controller-tracked seconds since the last EFFECTIVE (non-HOLD) action, capped per experiment.yaml rl.time_since_scale_cap_seconds.
